title: Yes Beach - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
Nestled in the charming beachside community of Old Florida Cottages, just south of 30A, this beautifully furnished four-bedroom, three-bath retreat offers the perfect blend of coastal comfort and relaxation. Unwind on the spacious porches while taking in breathtaking Gulf sunsets, or take a short stroll to the sugar-white sands via the nearby Gulfview Heights beach access. Prefer to stay close? Enjoy the community pool with family and friends.

Inside, the first-floor king owner's suite features a private en suite with an oversized shower and direct access to the wraparound porch. This level also includes a second king bedroom and a cozy bunk room, both sharing a well-appointed bath. Upstairs, the open-concept second floor boasts a bright and airy living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining space perfect for gathering. An additional bedroom on this level provides extra comfort.

For the ultimate beach getaway, the third-floor tower room offers a fun and spacious retreat, sleeping six with two sets of bunks. Whether you're here for sun-soaked beach days or laid-back evenings on the porch, this coastal escape is ready to welcome you!

YES BEACH Highlights:

- 5 Minute Walk to the Beach (without crossing the busy Highway)! - Community Pool (Seasonally Heated in Spring) Across the Street! - 4 Adult Bikes - 6-Seater Golf Cart - Beach gear - Fully stocked Kitchen - Pack n Play - Standard (drip-style) & Keurig Coffee Machines - Smart TVs in Every Bedroom (+ Living Room)! - 2 Patios/Balconies with Seating - Propane (provided) Grill - Wireless Internet - Parking for TWO (2) Vehicles in the Driveway - Walking Distance To Local Restaurants - Recently Renovated

Beach Access: Located approximately 0.3 miles (a 5-min walk) from the Gulfview Heights Public Beach Access.

Pool Access: Across the street from the community pool, including grills & restrooms!

Pool is heated for the months of March-April & Thanksgiving.

Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 14):

First Floor: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Walk-in Shower - Guest Bedroom: Twin/Twin bunk, Shared Bathroom with Walk-in Shower - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Ensuite Bathroom with Shower

Second Floor: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

Third Floor - Bunk Room Two (2) Sets of Bunk Beds, One Twin over Full with twin Trundle and One Twin/Twin, Shared Bathroom with Tub Shower Combo on Second Floor

PARKING:

There is enough parking for 2 cars. There is overflow parking in the community on a first come first serve basis.

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
